name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine

items: The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

description.content: While you are at least [24m] away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at [200%] speed.

quote: "Then you will know that there is no escape. When hanging in the depths, you face the dark one."
